dataList.value: "*As per SEBI circular no SEBI/HO/CFD/DIL2/CIR/P/2019/76 dated 28 June 2019 all are requested to comply with the provisions of the aforementioned circular which states as below: Intermediaries shall retain physical application forms submitted by retail individual investors with UPI as a payment mechanism, for a period of six months and thereafter forward the same to the issuer/ Registrar to Issue. However in case of Electronic forms printouts of such applications need not be retained or sent to the issuer. Intermediaries shall, at all times, maintain the electronic records relating to such forms for a minimum period of three years."

dataList.title: Cut-off time for UPI Mandate Confirmation
dataList.value: 28-Aug-2026 (upto 5:00 PM) The cut-off time for UPI mandate acceptance is 05:00 PM on last day of IPO bidding. Further bids with confirmed status of mandate amount blocked (RC100) shall be considered as valid applications and hence investors are advised to submit their UPI applications in IPO well in advance to avoid any last minute technical/systemic constraints that may hamper their ability to participate in IPOs by successfully accepting the mandate.

tijori.business_description: Sumax Engineering Ltd., incorporated in 1994, manufactures and trades products for the automotive OEM and auto refinish markets. Its business segments include manufacturing and trading, offering adhesive tapes, abrasives, tools, body shop consumables, car care products and accessories.
